title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1986-03-25
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a dreamy first set and strong second‑set moments like Desolation Row, Tom Thumb and a confident Touch.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised as clear and full‑scope, finally giving the spring‑86 shows the sonic quality they deserved.  Musically the concert delivers a quick, dreamy opening, a concise Desolation Row, a fast Don't Sleaze and a serviceable Scarlet → Touch, plus confident performances of Tom Thumb, Black Peter and Lovelight, even if the set feels a bit shortened.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer gave 5 stars, highlighting both superb recording fidelity for an audience source and a solid musical performance despite some set‑list brevity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, full‑scope audience tape that finally matches the sonic quality of earlier years; no major dropouts or muddiness noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Dreamy, quick opening first set that becomes a bit concise; second set is brisk and pleasant with strong transitions despite missing the hoped‑for Scarlet > Fire.

band_member_comments.Phil: New bass approach noted, especially on Touch.
